title: Wings rehearse in Nashville | 1974
content:
Wings rehearsed in Nashville, Tennessee, on 13 June 1974.

The rehearsals took place at the farm owned by songwriter Claude ‘Curly’ Putman Jr. Wings stayed at the farm, which they rented for $2,000 a week, and rehearsed in the garage.

On this day they primarily worked on the songs ‘Live And Let Die’ and ‘My Love’.

In the evening guitarists Denny Laine and Jimmy McCulloch, plus drummer Geoff Britton and the band’s roadies, explored the local bars. Britton was teetotal but the others all got drunk.

In one bar they met a local policeman who, improbably, gave Britton a gun, since he didn’t own one. The following day Britton accidentally discharged the weapon, arousing the ire of Paul McCartney who threatened to kick him out of Wings.
